description: Fetch and parse a domain's SPF record: authorized senders (ip4/ip6/mx/a/include), lookup count against the 10-DNS-lookup limit, and the final policy qualifier. Flags too-permissive (+all), missing records and over-limit configurations that silently break mail delivery. Use this when an agent needs to sender Policy Framework parse + policy grade. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_spf_check
title: SPF Record Check
